headword: {選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}

definitions.explanation: Activities carried out to gain votes in an election, including speeches, canvassing, advertising, and other promotional efforts.

examples.japanese: {選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The candidate was campaigning in front of the station since morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧や⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, the period and methods of election campaigning are strictly defined by law.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (election) and ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (movement, campaign). Refers to all organized activities aimed at winning votes during an election.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to campaign
- {選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ — campaign period
- {選挙運動|せんきょうんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}する→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧ — to conduct a campaign
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な{選挙運動|せんきょうんどう} — illegal campaigning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {選挙活動|せんきょかつどう} — election activities (broader; includes non-campaign activities)
- ⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧ — campaign (loanword; also used for non-political promotions)
- {政治活動|せいじかつどう} — political activities (broader than election-specific)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's {公職選挙法|こうしょくせんきょほう} (Public Offices Election Act) strictly regulates campaigning. Campaign periods are short (typically 12–17 days), door-to-door canvassing is prohibited, and candidates use designated vehicles with loudspeakers (⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦カー→カー：00130_kaa⟧) that are a distinctive feature of Japanese elections.
